What if you held your pee every day?
Teachers, nurses, drivers and gamers often hold it for hours. Your bladder stretches like a balloon and can hold about two cups. When it's about half full, your bladder sends the first signal to go.

But here's the twist. Holding it too often can weaken your bladder muscles over time and raise your risk of urinary tract infections. Most adults pee about six to eight times a day, so going when you feel the urge is the healthy choice. In rare cases, holding it way too long can stretch the bladder so much that it struggles to empty.
